games.note: Kickoff undetermined in the April 23 release; the 6 p.m. ET kickoff is supplied by the club's August 25, 2014 notice (library/2014_nfl_calendar.md, source row for the August 26 and 30 deadlines; corroborated by the club's August 27 travel notice) and was entered when the clock reached August 25.
